children.game_version: The 'Hangman's Tag': players must freeze in a 'salto dell'impiccato' pose when tagged.

avoid: Inward-turned positions if hip issues exist
seniors.seated_version: Focus on the 'vortex' energy in the torso and the 'hangman' arm contrast while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Practice the 'Spanish' neutral foot positions with barre support; avoid jumps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo by half; focus on the 'wrapping' foot movements at floor level.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: In specific moves like the 'salto dell'impiccato', arms are described as 'falling' to contrast with the trunk.
movement_profile.footwork: Uses 'false positions' (inwardly turned) or 'Spanish positions' (neutral). Includes wrapping steps and sprung steps.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Theatrical stage; often part of a series of tableaux (entrée de ballet).
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: The body acts as a 'vortex of force' to articulate kinetic principles.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: High elevation jumps and airborne steps are central to the repertory.
movement_profile.partnering: Generally solo virtuosity within a group setting; not described as partner-dependent.
movement_profile.posture: Variable; can involve a rigid trunk contrasted with falling arms, or a 'vortex of force' where the body concentrates energy.

signature_moves.description: Hangman's jump; high elevation with a rigid trunk and falling arms, landing on one foot.
signature_moves.name: Salto dell'impiccato

signature_moves.description: Revolving for as many turns as possible on a single leg.
signature_moves.name: Pirouette on one foot

signature_moves.description: Airborne steps involving interweaving and beating the legs.
signature_moves.name: Cabrioles

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid standard French turnout (en dehors) when performing specific grotesque positions; avoid 'amateur' two-footed pirouettes.

music_profile.musical_form: Entrée de ballet; comic opera sequences
music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by its lighthearted and comic tone, designed to accompany the antics of buffoons. It often features rhythmic shifts that support virtuosic displays like jumps and rapid turns.

basic_steps: Assume a 'false position' with feet turned slightly inward.
Execute a 'salto dell'impiccato' by jumping high with a rigid torso and limp arms.
Perform a 'cabriole' by beating the legs together in the air.
Execute a pirouette on one foot, maintaining balance for multiple rotations.
Land on one foot with the second leg extended and detached in the air.
teaching.formation: Soloist or small groups within a theatrical tableau or 'entrée'.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high-level athletic conditioning and previous experience in balletic turns.
teaching.rhythm: Varies by theatrical score; typically upbeat and punctuated to match athletic jumps.
